tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search currently active, reviewed, publicly listed Hirehouse roles. Every word in `query` must match the role's title, company, location or description. If nothing matches, related roles are returned instead with match: "related". Supports location, work mode, compensation, featured, recency, and so

tools.name: compare_jobs
tools.description: Compare two to five public HireHouse roles side by side by job ID. Returns public listing data, a description excerpt per role, and each role's HireHouse application URL.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Get the public details, full description and Hirehouse portal application URL for one job.

tools.name: show_jobs
tools.description: Display one to ten public HireHouse roles, by job ID, as interactive job cards. Each card links to that role's application page on the HireHouse portal.
